name: Jehoiada
bio:
Jehoiada the priest protected the hidden boy-king Joash through six years of Athaliah's usurped reign, then organized his coronation. In the seventh year, he made a covenant with the temple guard captains, showed them the king's son, and armed them with King David's old spears and shields from the temple. He had Joash crowned, anointed, and acclaimed king inside the temple, and when Athaliah rushed in crying "Treason," Jehoiada ordered her taken outside the temple grounds and killed, insisting she not be slain in the LORD's house itself. He then made a covenant between the LORD, the king, and the people, led the crowd in tearing down the house of Baal and killing Mattan, Baal's priest, and set Joash on the throne of Judah (2 Kings 11:4-20).

## 📖 Core Story: Overseeing the Temple Repairs

Jehoiada continued to instruct Joash as he grew, keeping him doing right in the LORD's eyes throughout that time. When the priests failed for over two decades to use temple funds to repair the building's damage, Jehoiada set up a collection chest by the altar instead, and once it filled, had the money paid out faithfully to the workmen until the temple was fully repaired (2 Kings 12:1-15).
